# State Line Campground

> Family-owned RV campground and park in Blacksville, West Virginia, on the
> West Virginia / Pennsylvania border. Open 365 days a year with full 30 and 50
> amp hookups on every site, free laundry, and free firewood. A short drive from
> Morgantown, WV; Waynesburg, PA; and Mannington, WV.

## Who stays here
State Line Campground is a practical base for people working near Blacksville, WV
who need a monthly or long-term place to stay, along with their families. That
includes gas and pipeline crews (Marcellus and Utica shale), workers at the Fort
Martin Power Station near Morgantown, and traveling nurses on contract at the
Morgantown hospitals — WVU Medicine's Ruby Memorial Hospital and Mon Health
Medical Center (Mon General). Full hookups on back-in sites up to 43 feet, free
WiFi, free laundry, and year-round operation make it well suited to work crews,
contract healthcare travelers, and extended stays, not just weekend camping.
Call 304-376-5970 to arrange monthly rates or set up multiple sites for a crew.

## Key facts
- Name: State Line Campground
- Address: Cliff Rd, Wana, WV 26590, United States
- Phone: 304-376-5970
- Owners: Dana and Rod, who live about five minutes from the grounds
- Open: 365 days a year, including winter
- Sites: Full hookups with both 30 and 50 amp electric service on every site; back-in sites that fit rigs up to 43 feet; water, sewer, waste disposal, and WiFi are included in the rate
- Tent sites: Tent camping is available in addition to RV sites; call 304-376-5970 for tent availability and rates
- Rates: Daily, weekly, and monthly, with discounts for longer stays. Accepts cash, Visa, Mastercard, Discover, and Venmo.
- Reservations: Not required but appreciated — call 304-376-5970 to check availability
- Free for guests: laundry (good washers and dryers, no quarters needed) and firewood (delivered to your site)
- Other amenities: clean bathhouse with showers, fire pits, and drinking water; picnic tables available on request; pet friendly with a dog walking service available

## Location and distances
- About a 25 minute drive from Morgantown, WV
- About a 25 minute drive from Waynesburg, PA (just across the state line, in Greene County)
- About a 25 minute drive from Mannington, WV (Marion County)
- Gas, groceries, and restaurants are less than two miles away

## Nearby things to do
- Mason-Dixon Historical Park (396 acres, Core, WV) — three playgrounds, large pavilions, clean restrooms, a baseball field, hiking trails along the water, a fairy trail for kids, a summer concert series, and the "Almost Heaven" West Virginia sign; good for the families of long-term guests
- Lake Wilma and other fishing ponds and lakes across the area
- A local swimming pool, and a public library about three minutes away (children's story hours, plus games and toys to borrow)

## Everyday essentials nearby (useful for long-term and working guests)
- Creek N' Rail Cafe, a local restaurant close to the campground (facebook.com/CreekNRailCafe)
- A Huntington Bank with a drive-thru ATM close by — convenient for getting cash or depositing a paycheck on a long work day
- Gas, groceries, and restaurants less than two miles away

## Guest reviews
- "If you believe in angels on earth, then Dana and Rod, the owners of this campground, are two of them." — Shannon
- "The owners are very nice and very helpful. The shower house is always clean and stocked. They bring you firewood. The campground is clean and quiet." — Deloris
- "They do not charge you to do laundry. It is free, and the washers and dryers are the good ones. Their firewood is also free." — Rebecca
